scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec mongo sh -c 'mongosh -u $MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME -p $MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD --authenticationDatabase admin portal_noticias'
scripts.db:limpar: docker compose exec mongo sh -c 'mongosh -u $MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME -p $MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD --authenticationDatabase admin portal_noticias --eval "db.autores.deleteMany({}); db.leitores.deleteMany({}); db.posts.deleteMany({}); db.comentarios.deleteMany({})"'
